text_en: Now when Jesus had finished instructing his twelve disciples, he went on from there to teach and proclaim his message in their cities.
text_cn: 耶稣嘱咐完了他的十二门徒，就从那里走了，为在他们的城里施教宣讲。

text_en: When John heard in prison what the Messiah was doing, he sent word by his disciples
text_cn: 若翰在狱中听到了基督所行的，就派遣他的门徒去，

text_en: and said to him, “Are you the one who is to come, or are we to wait for another? ”
text_cn: 对他说：“你就是要来的那一位，或是我们还要等候另一位？”

text_en: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John what you hear and see:
text_cn: 耶稣回答他们说：“你们去，把你们所见所闻的报告给若翰：

text_en: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the poor have good news brought to them.
text_cn: 瞎子看见，瘸子行走，癞病人得了洁净，聋子听见，死人复活，穷苦人得了喜讯。

text_en: And blessed is anyone who takes no offense at me. ”
text_cn: 凡不因我而绊倒的，是有福的！”

text_en: As they went away, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to look at? A reed shaken by the wind?
text_cn: 他们走后，耶稣就对群众论若翰说：“你们出去到荒野里，是为看什么呢？为看风摇曳的芦苇吗？

text_en: What then did you go out to see? Someone dressed in soft robes? Look, those who wear soft robes are in royal palaces.
text_cn: 你们出去到底是为看什么？为看一位穿细软衣服的人吗？啊！那穿细软衣服的人是在王宫里。

text_en: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
text_cn: 你们究竟为什么出去？为看一位先知吗？是的！我给你们说：而且他比先知还大。

text_en: This is the one about whom it is written, ‘See, I am sending my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way before you. ’
text_cn: 关于这人，经上记载说：‘看，我派遣我的使者在你面前，他要在你前面预备你的道路。’

text_en: Truly I tell you, among those born of women no one has arisen greater than John the Baptist; yet the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：在妇女所生者中，没有兴起一位比洗者若翰更大的；但在天国里最小的，也比他大。

text_en: From the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven has suffered violence, and the violent take it by force.
text_cn: 由洗者若翰的日子直到如今，天国是以猛力夺取的，以猛力夺取的人，就攫（jué）取了它，

text_en: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John came;
text_cn: 因为众先知和法律讲说预言，直到若翰为止。

text_en: and if you are willing to accept it, he is Elijah who is to come.
text_cn: 若是你们愿意接受，他就是那位要来的厄里亚。

text_en: Let anyone with ears listen!
text_cn: 有耳的，听吧！”

text_en: “But to what will I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling to one another,
text_cn: “我可把这一代比作什么呢？它像坐在大街上的儿童，向其他的孩子喊叫，

text_en: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we wailed, and you did not mourn. ’
text_cn: 说：我们给你们吹了笛，你们却不跳舞；我们唱了哀歌，你们却不捶胸。

text_en: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon’;
text_cn: 若翰来了，也不吃，也不喝，他们便说：他附了魔；

text_en: the Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Look, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners! ’ Yet wisdom is vindicated by her deeds. ”
text_cn: 人子来了，也吃也喝，他们却说：看哪！一个贪吃嗜酒的人，税吏和罪人的朋友！但智慧必藉自己的工程彰显自己的正义。”

text_en: Then he began to reproach the cities in which most of his deeds of power had been done, because they did not repent.
text_cn: 那时，耶稣就开始谴责那曾看过他许多异能的城邑，因为她们没有悔改：

text_en: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the deeds of power done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
text_cn: “苛辣匝因，你是有祸的！贝特赛达，你是有祸的！因为在你们那里所行的异能，如果行在提洛和漆冬，她们早已身披苦衣，头上撒灰做补赎了。

text_en: But I tell you, on the day of judgment it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon than for you.
text_cn: 但是我给你们说：在审判的日子，提洛和漆冬所受的惩罚也要比你们容易忍受。

text_en: And you, Capernaum, will you be exalted to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades. For if the deeds of power done in you had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
text_cn: 还有你，葛法翁！莫非你要被高举到天上吗？将来你必下到阴府里；因为在你那里所行的异能，如果行在索多玛，她必会存留到今天。

text_en: But I tell you that on the day of judgment it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom than for you. ”
text_cn: 但是我给你们说：在审判的日子，索多玛地所受的惩罚也要比你们容易忍受。”

text_en: At that time Jesus said, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and the intelligent and have revealed them to infants;
text_cn: 就在那时候，耶稣发言说：“父啊！天地的主宰！我称谢你，因为你将这些事瞒住了智慧和明达的人，而启示给小孩子。

text_en: yes, Father, for such was your gracious will.
text_cn: 是的，父啊！你原来喜欢这样。

text_en: All things have been handed over to me by my Father; and no one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and anyone to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.
text_cn: 我父将一切交给了我；除了父外，没有人认识子；除了子和子所愿意启示的人外，也没有人认识父。

text_en: “Come to me, all you that are weary and are carrying heavy burdens, and I will give you rest.
text_cn: 凡劳苦和负重担的，你们都到我跟前来，我要使你们安息。

text_en: Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me; for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
text_cn: 你们背起我的轭（è），跟我学吧！因为我是良善心谦的：这样你们必要找得你们灵魂的安息，

text_en: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light. ”
text_cn: 因为我的轭（è）是柔和的，我的担子是轻松的。”
